analysis.summary: Utssav CZ Gold Jewels Limited reported strong financial growth for H2 FY26 and FY26, driven by festive demand, new client additions, and a diversified product portfolio. Management outlined expansion plans including capacity increases, new product lines like plain gold and diamond jewelry, and an upcoming UAE subsidiary to scale international operations. The company guided for robust revenue and volume growth in the coming years while maintaining operational margins. Utssav CZ Gold Jewels Limited released its investor presentation for the audited financial results of H2 FY26 and FY26, reporting total income of ₹1,157.46 Cr and PAT of ₹59.06 Cr for FY26. Management highlighted robust growth driven by festive and wedding season demand, repeat orders, and the addition of 112 new clients alongside portfolio expansion into plain gold and diamond segments.

guidance.claim: The company expects around 60% revenue growth for the coming year.
guidance.quote: And just coming year also we are looking out for growth around 60% from last year.

guidance.claim: Management targets around 35% to 40% volume growth for FY27.
The company is targeting around INR4,000 crores to INR5,000 crores business around 2030.
guidance.quote: And as we have a lot of demands from our existing customers and we are trying new customers and we are opening office also in UAE. So, yes, yes, we have a lot of, we look around INR4,000 crores to INR5,000 crores business around 2030.

guidance.claim: Management guided for full-year revenue in the range of INR1,100 crores to INR1,200 crores.
guidance.quote: With trajectory, we are confident of closing the year in the range of INR1,100 crores to INR1,200 crores, making yet another year of strong growth and scale.

guidance.claim: Management stated a target of reaching INR4,000 crores to INR5,000 crores by FY 2030.
guidance.quote: So, FY 2030, we look around INR4,000 to INR5,000 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand for jewelry in India is very high.
demand_outlook.quote: See the demand is too much about jewelry in India.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand was driven by festive and wedding seasons, repeat business, and deeper penetration.
demand_outlook.quote: During the year, we witnessed healthy demand driven by festive and wedding seasons, sales repeat business from existing customers, and deeper penetration across both existing and new markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Gold prices being high has not affected the jewelry business demand across India.
demand_outlook.quote: Gold prices were high last quarter also, and last to last quarter also. So, demand is there all over India. So, it has not affected our business in terms of gold prices.

demand_outlook.claim: Management reported that growth was driven by healthy festive and wedding season demand, repeat orders from existing customers, and the addition of 112 new clients.
demand_outlook.quote: driven by healthy festive and wedding season demand, repeat orders from existing customers, and the addition of 112 new clients.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that capacity has been increased because jewelry demand is very good.
demand_outlook.quote: And expansion is, well, means capacity, Yes, we've increased because the demand is very good in our jewelry.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the second half of the year typically sees higher demand due to festive and wedding seasons.
demand_outlook.quote: This is the festive season. This is the wedding season. So, there is a lot of demand every time in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: Management reported that early client response to the newly introduced diamond jewelry range has been extremely encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The early response from our clients to our diamond jewellery range has been extremely encouraging and reinforcers are confident in this segment.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board recently approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary in the United Arab Emirates.
capex_expansion.quote: Our Board recently approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary in the United Arab Emirates.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans a capex of around INR50 crores for the year.
Management is planning to expand capacity to around 6 to 7 tons a year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are planning to expand and make it, means we are planning to acquire more buildings and all around where our capacity would go around 6 to 7 tons a year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received board approval in 2026 to incorporate a wholly-owned UAE subsidiary.
capex_expansion.quote:
2026 Receives Board Approval to Incorporate
Wholly-Owned UAE Subsidiary

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that installed capacity grew from 750 kg in FY22 to 1.5 to 1.6 tons in FY25.
capex_expansion.quote: Our installed capacity has grown from 750 kg in FY22 to 1.5 to 1.6 tons in FY25.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that capacity has been expanded to approximately 2.5 tons.
capex_expansion.quote: So, it's 1.5 tons to 6 tons. And we have increased it to 2.5 tons, approx.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to expand globally by participating in exhibitions and opening an office in Dubai.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we are now participating in international exhibitions in Dubai which is going to be held in November. So, Yes. We are going international level also by exhibiting over there. And we have a plan to open an office in Dubai.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for H2 FY26 improved by 40 basis points to 7.15%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin improved by 40 basis points to 7.15%, while PAT margin expanded by 17 basis points to 4.35%.

margins_costs.claim: Operational PAT margin is expected to be around 4% to 4.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Around, yes, 4% to 4.5% PAT margin and EBITDA around 7% to 8%.

margins_costs.claim: Operating cash flow is negative because the company keeps ready stock of gold and inventory.
margins_costs.quote: The operation cash flow is negative because we buy all the gold, means we keep the stock ready. Our stock is always means we have a ready stock. That is why we have a negative cash flow.

margins_costs.claim: Despite volatility in gold prices, the company maintained strong operational momentum through lightweight jewellery offerings and efficient inventory management.
margins_costs.quote: Despite volatility in gold prices, we maintained strong operational momentum through our differentiated lightweight jewellery offerings, efficient inventory management, and customer-centric innovation approach.

margins_costs.claim: Higher contribution from natural diamond jewellery and new product lines in plain gold and lab-grown diamonds enhanced the product mix and realizations.
margins_costs.quote: During the year, we strengthened our product portfolio through a higher contribution from natural diamond jewellery and the introduction of new product lines in plain gold and lab-grown diamonds, which enhanced our product mix and realizations.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that EBITDA for H1 FY26 increased by 184% to INR45 crores, with margin improving by 388 basis points to 9.45%.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA increased by 184% to INR45 crores, with margin improving by 388 basis points to 9.45% profit after tax, rose 197% to INR29 crores, with margin improving by 271 basis points to 6.17, while EPS grew 124% to INR12.09 per share.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that sustainable EBITDA is expected to be in the range of 9% to 10%.
margins_costs.quote: So, 9% to 10% should be EBITDA sustainable.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that employee expenses will increase very marginally as business scales.
margins_costs.quote: It means very marginally high. Assume that 2-5-10 marketing people will increase. Not like something... It won't double.

orders_capacity.claim: Current manufacturing capacity stands at around 2,500 kilos.
Capacity utilization is managed at around 65% overall and goes up to 90% in season.
orders_capacity.quote: Around 65%. So, in season it goes up to 90% and it's like managed 65% overall.

orders_capacity.claim: The company onboarded 112 new clients during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: This momentum helped us onboard 112 new clients during FY26, significantly expanding our retailer network and strengthening our market presence.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current installed capacity is 2,000 kg per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company’s current installed capacity is 2,000 kg per annum and operates on a 100% B2B model, supplying directly to reputed jewellery retailers across 23 states and 2 Union Territories in India, as well as exporting to UAE.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that order fulfillment takes around 7 to 10 days.
orders_capacity.quote: Around 7 to 10 days. Around 7 to 10 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to fund additional requirements of around INR50 crores through bank borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes. Around INR50 crores we are taking additional funds.

capital_allocation.claim: Funding for growth will be borrowed from banks as debt.
Management stated plans to borrow around INR50 crores more from banks.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes. Yes. We are going to borrow more from the bank. Around INR50 crores we are planning to borrow.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted risks related to gold price volatility impacting margins.
Management noted that gold price fluctuations impact percentage-wise margins.

management_commitments.claim: Real diamond jewelry sales are expected to reach more than INR200 crores in a couple of years.
management_commitments.quote: And like in couple of years, we should be reaching around more than INR200 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Capacity utilization is expected to reach around 70% to 75% this year.
management_commitments.quote: So, that's what I am saying, from 65% it is going to go up to 75%.

management_commitments.claim: Export sales are expected to jump up to 10% to 20% immediately once the UAE subsidiary starts.
management_commitments.quote: So, once if UAE subsidiary starts, so its export sales will jump up to 10% to 20% immediately.

management_commitments.claim: The company maintains its target of reaching INR4,000 crores to INR5,000 crores business around 2030.
management_commitments.quote: And as we have a lot of demands from our existing customers and we are trying new customers and we are opening office also in UAE. So, yes, yes, we have a lot of, we look around INR4,000 crores to INR5,000 crores business around 2030.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that retailer relationships, B2B reach, and integrated manufacturing will continue to strengthen scalability and execution capabilities.
management_commitments.quote: As we move ahead, strong retailer relationships, expanding B2B reach, deeper market penetration, and integrated manufacturing and design capabilities will continue to strengthen scalability and execution capabilities.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach INR4,000 crores to INR5,000 crores in revenue by FY 2030.
management_commitments.quote: So, FY 2030, we look around INR4,000 to INR5,000 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to scale installed capacity to 6 to 7 tons annually by 2030.
Management plans to achieve INR200 crores to INR300 crores in diamond segment sales within 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Around INR200 crores-INR300 crores in 2 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
